queries.query: SELECT id as Id, titulo as Titulo, descricao as Descricao, data as Data, tipo_evento as TipoEvento, autor_id as AutorId, texto_acao as TextoAcao, link_acao as LinkAcao FROM evento
INSERT INTO evento (titulo, descricao, data, tipo_evento, autor_id, texto_acao, link_acao ) VALUES (@Titulo, @Descricao,@Data,@TipoEvento,@AutorId, @TextoAcao, @LinkAcao) RETURNING id;

SELECT e.id as Id, e.titulo as Titulo, e.descricao as Descricao, e.data as Data, e.tipo_evento as TipoEvento, e.autor_id as AutorId, e.texto_acao as TextoAcao, e.link_acao as LinkAcao, u.id as Usuario_Id, u.id as Id, u.nome as Nome, u.sobrenome as Sobrenome, u.email as Email, u.ra as Ra, u.curso as Curso, u.telefone as Telefone, u.imagem_url as ImagemUrl, u.ativo as Ativo, u.newsletter_subscriber as InscritoNoticia, u.cargo as Cargo, u.data_criacao as DataCriacao, u.data_atualizacao as DataAtualizacao FROM evento e LEFT JOIN usuario u ON e.autor_id = u.id WHERE e.id = @Id
UPDATE evento SET titulo = @Titulo, descricao = @Descricao, data = @Data, tipo_evento = @TipoEvento, texto_acao = @TextoAcao, link_acao = @LinkAcao WHERE id=@id

SELECT e.id as Id, e.titulo as Titulo, e.descricao as Descricao, e.data as Data, e.tipo_evento as TipoEvento, e.autor_id as AutorId, e.texto_acao as TextoAcao, e.link_acao as LinkAcao, COUNT(*) OVER() as TotalCount, u.id as Usuario_Id, u.id as Id, u.nome as Nome, u.sobrenome as Sobrenome, u.email as Email, u.ra as Ra, u.curso as Curso, u.telefone as Telefone, u.imagem_url as ImagemUrl, u.ativo as Ativo, u.newsletter_subscriber as InscritoNoticia, u.cargo as Cargo, u.data_criacao as DataCriacao, u.data_atualizacao as DataAtualizacao FROM evento e LEFT JOIN usuario u ON e.autor_id = u.id WHERE 1=1 AND (@SearchPattern IS NULL OR e.titulo ILIKE @SearchPattern OR e.descricao ILIKE @SearchPattern) AND (@Type IS NULL OR e.tipo_evento = @Type) AND (@DateFrom IS NULL OR e.data >= @DateFrom) AND (@DateTo IS NULL OR e.data <= @DateTo) ORDER BY e.data DESC OFFSET @Offset LIMIT @Limit
